note: Every variant is declared here and in docs/VIDEO-RESONANCE.md, with its hypothesis, before it runs. Selection between variants reads only the validation-channel pairs.

variants.name: v1
variants.hypothesis: The text recipe's exact shape on video: a head that keeps stock's same-channel, same-tier geometry (semantic term) while pulling co-outliers together (behavioral term at 0.144) separates outliers from controls better than stock on unseen channels.

variants.name: v2
variants.hypothesis: At 0.144 the semantic term dominates and the head relearns stock geometry with loss while the co-outlier term barely moves; equal weight lets co-outlier structure shape the space.

variants.name: v3
variants.hypothesis: v2 stopped at 5 epochs: the validation drop is drift on the 34 training channels; the behavioral loss flattens by epoch 5 while the semantic loss keeps falling.

variants.name: v3b
variants.hypothesis: The one retry of v3 at the same bar (Brendan, via the models window, 2026-10-21): the behavioral groups' 7 negatives drawn uniformly from the label-blind sample on training channels, restoring the catalog's ~14.8% outperformer rate in the pool, so a co-outlier group stops pushing outliers away from outliers; positives, semantic groups and every setting unchanged.
